Measured equilibria u=0->0.206, 0.25->0.491, 0.27->0.501, 0.30->0.53 give overall K~1.1 and local K~0.5-0.8, tau~150s, delay<30s, no deadzone near target, one-sided negative spikes. Kp=1.0 gives closed-loop ~65s tau without delay instability, Ki=0.012 trims offset, gated to |e|<0.15 plus saturation freeze to prevent windup during 0.2->0.5 heat-up. Clip +-0.045 plus 15s filter rejects 0.05-0.13 spikes while tracking 0.006/s true rate. Integral +-0.15/0.20 leaves >0.13 authority to fix feedforward error, u capped 0.75 for 0.10 margin to soft 0.85/hard 0.90.
